title: Remove deprecated old places of filters and MEP modules
body:
This MR suggest removing old places of filters and MEP modules deprecated in ASE 3.23.0 with `FutureWarning`.

# Checklist

- [x] I am familiar with [ASE's contribution guidelines](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/contribute.html).
- [~] [**Doc strings**](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/python_codingstandard.html#writing-documentation-in-the-code) in code changed in this MR are up to date.
- [~] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/tests.html)
- [~] [**Issue is resolved** via "closes #XXXX" if applicable.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/managing_issues.html#closing-issues-automatically)
author: yuzie007

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Thank you @yuzie007. +1 to remove this, but let's do it after the release.  After all, getting rid of it has no effect on the release even if it simplifies our life in the future.

comments.author: schiotz
comments.body: Making this pass the selftest requires a fix in Asap.  I'll try to do that quickly and make a new release.

comments.author: schiotz
yuzie007
comments.body:
Thank you so much @schiotz for the update on the Asap side.
I could run the tests with the updated `asap-3.13.6` on my laptop.

To pass the pipeline, we need to rebuild the docker image of `ase-dockers:main` to install the latest Asap.
Since I do not have a linux environment, this is a bit difficult for me.
@askhl could you maybe do this?

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body: (Probably) thanks to recent update of docker images, now this MR passes the tests.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Thank you very much @yuzie007, I suppose we can go on with this now.  Merging!
